comments.text:
Decision (PRINCIPAL): stop chasing Gemini web's fetch failure; ship for OpenAI + Claude for now. Revisit Gemini later ("something else for Gemini").

Diagnosis (every server-side cause eliminated):
- GitHub Pages returns HTTP 200 to every UA tested (Googlebot, empty, GeminiBot), both Pages and raw.
- denson.github.io/robots.txt is 404 (no robots.txt) — nothing disallowed.
- brief.html fails identically to AGENTS.md, so it is not the filename or .md content-type.
=> The failure is internal to Gemini web's browsing; Gemini doesn't know why and CONFABULATES causes ("GitHub blocks all AI", "UA filtering", "security handshakes") — all empirically false. Same hallucination reflex it showed inventing fake "reviews."

Validated targets:
- GPT (browsing): fetches AGENTS.md fine; behaved as designed (advisory, honest about non-fit, absorbed no-overclaim).
- Claude: home environment.
- Gemini web: cannot fetch; paste-the-text is the only reliable path today. The README don't-guess line was validated this session — it made Gemini ABSTAIN and ask for the paste instead of hallucinating.

"Something else for Gemini" — future plan (not now):
1. Test the Gemini API / AI Studio url_context tool, which DOES fetch URLs (different path from the consumer web app).
2. Try a Gem preloaded with the brief text.
3. Re-test consumer Gemini after Google indexes the Pages site (its browse may lean on Google's index; a freshly-published path may be unreachable until crawled).
Meanwhile paste-the-text is the documented Gemini method in the README.

title: Gemini web can't fetch our Pages URLs — parked; ship targets = OpenAI + Claude
